action.objective: Complete broad search over all 20 legal opening moves to identify a sound development plan.
action.rationale: Initial position; no prior evidence. Broad search over all legal root moves is required at depth 4 within the 3000-node broad-search allowance. This will compare central pawn advances (e2e4, d2d4), knight development (g1f3, b1c3) and other options on material, center control, king safety and development, before selecting a single candidate for verification.
